dedupe_keys.name: 5g macro cell signal dataset for complex terrain uav and ground measurements chongqing

description: This dataset presents fifth-generation (5G) macro-cell signal measurements collected by unmanned aerial vehicle and ground surveys over a 9 square kilometre area of complex terrain, released by Nuo Xu of Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications with a Data Descriptor in the journal Sensors. Raw records give reference signal received power and quality (RSRP, RSRQ), signal to interference plus noise ratio, GNSS coordinates, altitude, timestamps and cell identifiers; a processed grid of 10,000 cells combines them with a digital elevation model, vegetation index, building morphology, anonymised base station attributes from the operator and engineered variables, with observation or interpolation labels. Coverage: one hilly urban-edge area in Chongqing, China, a measurement campaign published on 6 June 2026. Format and access: CSV grid data, a data dictionary, a loading script and checksums on Zenodo; free under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Caveats: a single small area and operator; interpolated grid values are labelled and should not be taken as measurements. Simulation uses: calibration and validation of radio propagation and coverage models such as Sionna or SPLAT in terrain, and radio environment maps for network planning. Related records: Mon Réseau Mobile and OpenBarres give national measurements, and the ITM and Sionna models predict coverage.
